author: ZeroHedge
text:
UPDATE: The US Embassy in Manama, Bahrain, just sent the same alert to US citizens in the country.
Right now we have:

- Jerusalem (Israel)
- Muscat (Oman) 
- Beirut (Lebanon)
- Baghdad (Iraq)
- Manama (Bahrain)
